items.headline: Utilities Commission to Review Proposed Reserve Fund Policy Changes
items.summary: The Utilities Advisory Commission is set to discuss a Baker Tilly advisory report and consider recommending updated reserve management policies to the City Council, which could affect how much money the city keeps on hand to buffer utility rates.

items.headline: Town Council to consider vacating easement at Cerro Vista
items.summary: Los Gatos is set to adopt a resolution summarily vacating a public service easement at 15995 Cerro Vista.
